Fresh.storage_condition: Cool pantry or refrigerator crisper drawer.
Fresh.recommendation: Optimal for raw consumption. Wash thoroughly before eating.

Overripe.recommendation: Texture softening. Best utilized in baking, applesauce, or smoothies.

Rotten.storage_condition: Do not store with healthy produce.
Rotten.recommendation: Spoiled. Discard immediately to prevent cross-contamination.

Fresh.storage_condition: Store at room temperature away from direct sunlight.
Fresh.recommendation: Ideal for direct consumption or fruit salads.

Overripe.storage_condition: Room temperature or peel and freeze.
Overripe.recommendation: High sugar content. Ideal for banana bread, pancakes, or frozen desserts.

Fresh.storage_condition: Keep at room temperature until fully ripe, then refrigerate.
Fresh.recommendation: Firm and aromatic. Perfect for fresh slicing or salads.

Overripe.recommendation: Very soft. Best used for purees, mango lassi, or chutneys.

Rotten.recommendation: Signs of decay or mold. Discard immediately.
